arguments.title: Isolated failures in cluster 6_05 involving 'not say given' neutral sentences misclassified as negative
arguments.hypothesis: Cluster 6_05 predominantly contains neutral-labeled sentences with phrases like 'not say given' that the candidate model misclassifies as negative in isolated cases despite overall accuracy improvement.
missing_evidence: More cases and independent confirmation cohort to assess operational impact and prevalence
